title: Entropy-Regularized Finite-State Mean Field Control: Regularity and Stability
summary: We study infinite-horizon discounted mean field control of finite-state continuous-time Markov chains with unbounded transition rates and a relative-entropy rate penalty. Under mild assumptions, the value function is the unique bounded viscosity solution of the stationary Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation on the closed probability simplex. Joint convexity of a quadratically corrected flux Lagrangian and smoothness of the data yield global semiconvexity, intrinsic $\mathcal{C}^{1,1}$ regularity, and optimal Gibbs feedback.
